Average age of 9 students is 42 years. Average age of first four persons is 45 years. Average age of fifth and sixth person together is 3 years more than the age of last person. Age of eighth person is 80% of the age of seventh person. If average age of eighth and nineth person is 34 years, then what is the age of seventh person?
questions.solution_en:
Let the age of eighth person = 'z' years

Age of nineth person = (68 - z) years

ATQ,

Total age of 9 students = 9*42 = 378

4*45 + 2(68 - z + 3) + 5z/4 + z + (68 - z) = 378

180 + 142 - 2z + 9z/4 + 68 - z = 378

3z/4 = 12

z = 16

Hence, the age of seventh person = 16 * 100/80 = 20 years

questions.q_en: The thickness of a spherical metallic shell is 3 cm and external radius of the shell is 9 cm. The density of the shell is 14/11 mg/cubic cm. Find the mass of the shell.
questions.solution_en:
External radius of shell= 9 cm

Thickness of shell = 3 cm

Internal radius of shell = 9 - 3 = 6 cm

Volume of shell = 4/3* π* (93 - 63) =4/3* π* 513 = 684π cubic cm

Density of the shell = 14/11 mg/cm3

Mass of the shell = volume * density

= 684* 22/7* 14/11 = 684* 4 = 2736 mg.

questions.q_en: If 1 + a2 = 2/a, then what will be the value of 3a + 4/a + 5?
questions.solution_en:
1 + a2 = 2/a

a + a3 = 2

a3 + a - 2 = 0

a3 - 1 + a - 1 = 0

(a - 1)(a2 + a + 2) = 0

a = 1 or a2 + a + 2 = 0 (which is not possible as b2 - 4ac <0)

Therefore, a = 1

Putting the value in the question equation

3a + 4/a + 5 = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12

questions.q_en: Some pens are bought at 12 for Rs 100 and an equal number of pens at 18 for Rs 130. If all the pens are sold at Rs 120 per dozen then find the profit percentage (%).
questions.solution_en:
Given - pen at 12 for Rs 100 = pen at 18 for Rs 130

Let total pen (LCM of 12 & 18) = 36

Let 36 pens are bought at 12 for Rs 100

Then cost of 36 pens = 100 X 36/12 = 300 Rs

Let 36 pens are bought at 18 for Rs 130

Then cost of 36 pens = 130 X 36/18 = 260 Rs

Total cost of 72 pens = 300 + 260 = 560 Rs

SP of 12 pens = 120

SP of 1 pen = 120/12 = 10 Rs.

SP of 72 pens = 10 X 72 = 720 Rs.

Profit percent = profit X 100/CP

= (720 - 560) X 100 / 560

= 160 X 100 / 560

= 200/7

questions.q_en: Pipe X can fill a tank in 9 hours and Pipe Y can fill it in 21 hours. If they are opened on alternate hours and Pipe X is opened first, in how many hours shall the tank be full?
questions.solution_en:
X can fill it in 9 hours,

Y can fill it in 21 hours

L.C.M of 9 and 21 =63

Efficiency of X = 63/9=7

Efiiciency of Y = 63/21= 3

If X is opened first and then Y is opened next hour.

So in 2 hours they will work :- (7+3)= 10 units of work.

So in 12 hours they will work:- 10*6=60 units of work,

Now as again X will have to work for remaining 3 units of work

So it will take 3/7 hours to fill the remaining tank.

So total time needed =12+3/7 =87/7

Option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Compound interest on a sum at R% per annum for 2 years is 11% more than the simple interest on same sum at same rate of interest in same period. What is the value of R?
questions.solution_en:
Simple interest = sum * rate * time/100 = sum * R * 2/100 = sum * (2R/100)

Compound interest = sum * ((1 + rate/100)time - 1) = sum * ((1 + R/100)2 - 1) = sum * R(200 + R)/10000

Then, sum * R(200 + R)/10000 = (100 + 11)/100 * sum * (2R/100)

200 + R = 222

R = 22

questions.q_en: Find the perimeter and area of an isosceles triangle whose equal sides are 5 cm and the height is 4 cm.
questions.solution_en:
Applying Pythagoras theorem,

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Height)²

=> (5)² = (0.5 x Base of isosceles triangle)² + (4)²

=> 0.5 x Base of isosceles triangle = 3

=> Base of isosceles triangle = 6 cm

Therefore, perimeter = sum of all sides = 5 + 5 + 6 = 16 cm

Area of triangle = 0.5 x Base x Height = 0.5 x 6 x 4 = 12 cm²

questions.q_en: The sum of the two numbers is 45. Their HCF and LCM are 5 and 70 respectively. Find the sum of the reciprocal of the two numbers.
questions.solution_en:
Since the HCF of two numbers is 5, the let the numbers are 5a and 5b respectively. ['a' and 'b' are co-prime numbers and a > b.]

LCM of 5a and 5b = 5ab = 70

ab = 14 ...... (1)

Sum of two numbers = 5a + 5b = 45

a + b = 9 ....... (2)

From (1) and (2):

(a + b)/ab = 9/14

a/ab + b/ab = 9/14

1/b + 1/a = 9/14

Sum of reciprocal of the two numbers = 1/5a + 1/5b = 9/(5 * 14)

= 9/70

questions.q_en: A bus started running at 12:08 pm in the afternoon at a speed of 160 km/h and it halts for 10 minutes after travelling every 12 km, then at what time it will be 480 km away from starting point?
questions.solution_en:
Halting time = Number of halts * Time taken for each halting = (40 - 1) * 10 = 390 minutes = 6.5 hours

Total time to cover 480 km = 480/160 + 6.5 = 9.5 hours

So, the time at which the bus will be 480 km away from the starting point = 12:08 pm + 9 hours 30 minutes = 9:38 pm
